title: Texas high school volleyball: Big Country UIL Bi-District Playoff Schedule, Scores (Oct. 29-31) | State | lufkindailynews.com
text:
After three months of highly-competitive regular season action, the best teams in the Big Country are ready to compete in the 2026 Texas high school volleyball playoffs.
The Lone Star State’s best high school volleyball teams have punched their tickets to the postseason and will tip off the 2026 UIL Volleyball Playoffs when bi-district round games begin Thursday, Oct. 29, and wrap up by Saturday, Oct. 31.
The Big Country and Abilene area’s top teams will have their sights set on the 2026 UIL Volleyball State Tournament on Thursday-Saturday, Nov. 19-21 at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland, where 11 new state champions will be crowned.
Here’s a closer look at every matchup featuring Big Country teams competing in the bi-district round of the 2026 UIL Volleyball Playoffs:
2026 Texas High School Volleyball Playoffs – Big Country UIL Bi-District Pairings, Scores (Oct. 29-31)
